facts.text: The hotel is at 151 West 54th Street, between Sixth and Seventh Avenues, with MoMA a block south, Carnegie Hall three blocks north and Central Park just beyond.
facts.excerpt: 151 West 54th Street, between Sixth and Seventh Avenues. MoMA sits a block south, Carnegie Hall three north, and Central Park just beyond.

facts.text: Complimentary MoMA admission is available to hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Explore MoMA just steps away, with complimentary admission available to hotel guests

facts.text: Every suite is laid out like a London flat, with living space apart from the bedroom and a dedicated workspace.
facts.excerpt: Every suite follows the logic of a London flat. Living space sits apart from where you sleep, and a dedicated workspace means the two never compete for the same corner.

facts.text: The Park View suites and the Premium Park View Apartment look out across Central Park.
facts.excerpt: Our Park View suites and the 1,800 square foot Premium Park View Apartment look out across Central Park

facts.text: Rooms are designed with herringbone wood floors, hand-tufted rugs and Carrara marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Impeccably designed with herringbone wood floors, hand-tufted rugs and Carrara marble bathrooms

facts.text: Bathrooms have a whirlpool tub and marble vanities.
facts.excerpt: A whirlpool tub and marble vanities transform our bathrooms into a spa-like oasis.

facts.text: In-room comforts include an espresso machine, bathrobes and slippers.
facts.excerpt: Sophisticated comforts include an in-room espresso machine, bathrobes and slippers.

facts.text: The signature accommodations include the light-filled Atrium Suite, the Sky Suites and the Penthouse.
facts.excerpt: From the light-filled Atrium Suite to the elevated Sky Suites and Penthouse, The London NYC’s signature accommodations offer an exceptional sense of space and privacy.

facts.text: The hotel spans 54 floors in Midtown Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: Spanning 54 floors, The London NYC offers expansive accommodations that bring a sense of residential ease to Midtown Manhattan.

facts.text: A weekly Friday guided tour explores the hotel's art collection, with works by Matisse and Warhol alongside a Venice Biennale sculpture and a Turner Prize winner.
facts.excerpt: The 15-minute experience moves through the hotel with works by Matisse and Warhol alongside a Venice Biennale sculpture and a Turner Prize winner

facts.text: The hotel offers a weekly Friday guided tour of its art collection.
facts.excerpt: Discover the stories behind The London NYC’s art collection during our weekly Friday guided tour.

facts.text: Each evening Dabble serves a complimentary Epicurean Moment of seasonal bites paired with wines and beers made in New York State.
facts.excerpt: It is offered daily in Dabble at 5:30, complimentary, with seasonal bites paired against wines and beers made in New York State.

facts.text: Dabble, the hotel's American restaurant near Carnegie Hall, suits pre-theatre dining or a nightcap.
facts.excerpt: Warm and sophisticated, our Midtown Manhattan restaurant near Carnegie Hall is ideal for pre-theatre dining in NYC or a nightcap.

facts.text: The fitness center features Technogym equipment, including the Technogym Kinesis Personal Heritage.
facts.excerpt: A distinctive expression of form and function, the Technogym Kinesis Personal Heritage supports a wide range of natural movements through an elegant, space-conscious design.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at The London, a Luxury Collection Hotel, New York City do not permit rollaway beds.

facts.text: Nearly every accommodation at the hotel is a suite.
facts.excerpt: Because nearly every accommodation here is a suite, dining in is not the compromise you make on a tired night.

facts.text: The hotel says its room and suite sizes are among the largest in Midtown Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: Our generous hotel room and suite sizes are among the largest in Midtown Manhattan, New York
